newsitem.title: USA: KCS to buy InterCoast Oil.
newsitem.headline: KCS to buy InterCoast Oil.

text.p: KCS Energy Inc. said Friday it will buy InterCoast Oil & Gas Co., the Oklahoma-based oil and gas exploration and production subsidiary and two gas marketing units of MidAmerican Energy Co., for $210 million in cash, plus warrants.

KCS, an independent energy company, said it would give MidAmerican 435,000 warrants to buy KCS common stock. The warrants have a four-year term and an exercise price of $45 per share, the company said.
The acquisition is expected to close before year-end.
The Houston-based company also said it agreed separately to buy transferable tax credits for a net price of about $4 million.
KCS's stock fell 12.5 cents to $39.75, while MidAmerican slid 12.5 cents to $19 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
